rev0898 alert-tax correction: do not reuse the calibration head’s one-direction alert formula, its 4.31-bit row for (beta,alpha)=(0.01,0.05), or any claim that a necessary lower bound below a cap proves an alert fits. rev0897 MC-EQ correction: do not reuse the calibration head’s inherited T log2(1+2k delta_eq) formula, (k=8, delta_eq_eff=0.005, T=32) tuple, or 3.55-bit session export. For the 2026-01-23 spectral head, use the rev0769 corrected exact chi-squared boundary: ||D^t||_F^2-1 for fixed kernels, ||D_1...D_t||_F^2-1 for common-stationary schedules, and ||sum_t p_t D^t||_F^2-1 for hidden randomized lengths. One-step singular-power sums over i>=2 are exact only with a normal/reversible certificate; decay-to-zero requires ergodicity, and receipt chi2_bound values need Markov, Cantelli-with-certified-variance, evaluator-quantile, pointwise, or stronger tail/pointwise conversion.
